This [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''Jedi''' served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] in the last [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. He was [[Bone/Legends|bone]]-thin with horribly scarred skin and had unkempt [[Color/Legends|gray]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]]. At some point, he demonstrated his [[Force power/Legends|ability]] to conjure [[Force Light]] to fellow [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Beldorion]]. Many [[Standard year/Legends|years]] later, in [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]], [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] witnessed this man in a fragment of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt's]] memory through [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].<ref name="Planet of Twilight">''[[Planet of Twilight]]''</ref>
